zh.title: JEPA-Anything · 跨领域统一科学世界模型：面向潜在世界模型的正交预测因子分解
zh.summary: JEPA-Anything 用正交预测因子分解（OPF）把潜在目标拆成互补因子，各自学习后再组合，并在视觉、生物、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场和气象七个领域上评测；与匹配的 JEPA 基线相比，10 个动力学任务的报告指标均有提升。
body: JEPA-Anything 是一项面向潜在世界模型和正交预测因子分解的独立模型方法研究。
它探索如何在视觉、生物、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场和气象这七个领域中，学习能够预测世界状态变化的潜在表示，并为干预预测、状态合成和科学诊断提供统一接口。
在未来的研究愿景中，JEPA-Anything 可以被理解为面向多个科学环境的统一预测模型或科学世界模拟器：当研究者提出某种科学行为或干预时，模型预先预测可能的状态变化、结果和风险，帮助筛选无效或代价较高的方案。这是希望探索的能力方向：目前它并不能模拟所有科学环境，也尚未接入 ScienceBuddy 或 ScienceIDE。
在整体研究图景中，它关注如何表示复杂系统中的多种可预测因素、如何预测不同干预带来的状态变化、如何为实验选择和科学诊断提供预测依据，以及如何在跨领域场景中复用潜在世界状态接口。
论文提出正交预测因子分解（OPF）：在联合嵌入预测架构之上，把潜在目标拆成互补因子，各自通过专门的通路学习，再在共享的预测设计中组合。评测覆盖表示学习、干预预测、分布外泛化和长时程动力学，包含 10 个匹配的动力学任务、超过 1000 个临床事件的预测，以及四个体系上的 100 步分子 rollout。

与匹配的 JEPA 基线相比，全部 10 个动力学任务的报告指标都有提升，Interventional Pong 上的单次干预预测误差降低 34.8%；在所比较的方法中，四个体系的一步和 100 步分子误差都是最低的。一项由因子提名的生物干预在细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤组织块和小鼠中获得实验支持，潜在轨道模态复现开普勒标度指数，拟合斜率为 −1.4991。以上是在论文选定的领域和任务上的观察。
技术报告和 Hugging Face 上的模型集合已公开。本次发布不包含公开演示。
zh.short: JEPA-Anything 跨领域科学世界模型

en.title: JEPA-Anything · cross-domain unified science world model: orthogonal predictive factorisation for latent world models
en.summary: JEPA-Anything splits latent targets into complementary factors with orthogonal predictive factorisation (OPF), and is evaluated across vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields and weather. Against matched JEPA baselines, it improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks.
body: JEPA-Anything is an independent model-method study of latent world models and orthogonal predictive factorisation.

It explores how to learn latent representations that predict changes in world state, and how to offer one interface for intervention prediction, state synthesis and scientific diagnosis. The seven domains are vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields and weather.

In the research vision, JEPA-Anything can be read as a unified predictive model or science world simulator over many scientific environments: when a researcher proposes an action or intervention, the model predicts the likely state changes, outcomes and risks in advance, helping screen out ineffective or costly plans. That is a direction to explore: today it does not simulate every scientific environment, and it is not connected to ScienceBuddy or ScienceIDE.

In the wider research picture it asks how to represent the many predictable factors of a complex system, how to predict the state changes different interventions bring, how to ground experiment selection and scientific diagnosis in prediction, and how to reuse a latent world-state interface across domains.

The paper introduces orthogonal predictive factorisation (OPF): on top of joint-embedding predictive architectures it decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. The evaluation spans representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalisation and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems.

Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%; among the compared methods, its one-step and 100-step molecular errors are the lowest in all four systems. A factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumour fragments and mice, and latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These are observations on selected domains and tasks.
The technical report and the Hugging Face model collection are public. This release includes no public demo.
en.short: JEPA-Anything, a cross-domain science world model
